'''Ardray''' was a [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who led a detachment of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] to the [[Elysium]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], where they protected a number of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] studying there. However, Ardray and the Padawans were massacred by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial forces]], who planted evidence framing [[House Ulgo]] for the murders.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Shock Doctrine|Alderaan}}</ref>
